source: Wraith: The Oblivion 20th Anniversary Edition. Mechanics as codes and short summaries in WoDX's own words, with pages; read the book for the full rules.

thorns.e: Standing among Spectres.
Spectres or others who answer the Shadow.
A relic that appears only during Catharsis.
Each Slumber: a die a level at 6, an Angst a success; a Willpower turns it off for a scene.
Extra Attribute or Ability dots, only in Catharsis.
Slumber visions: Willpower at 6 or wake and lose Slumber's benefits; a Willpower beforehand protects.
+2 difficulty to her Social rolls.
The Shadow shows in reflections.
The Shadow calls to others: 1 Angst, roll permanent Angst at 7.
A pact that dooms the wraith on a condition.
Deceives the wraith's perceptions.
1 Angst a die: force a reroll of one of her dice (the Shadowguide picks), after the roll.
Her face shows the Shadow at times.
1 Angst: one sentence made compelling; temporary Angst against the hearer's Manipulation + Subterfuge; a Willpower resists.
Touching a wraith: 3 dice at 6 (a Willpower at 7 cancels successes); a Willpower turns it off for a scene.
The Shadow acts through shadows.
A servant creature of the Shadow.
1 Angst: a sudden action or blurted statement; Willpower at 7 resists.
The Shadow keeps a life of its own; Perception + Awareness at 8 to notice it's busy.
The Shadow whispers to others.
The Shadow takes a body that looks like hers.
A dare whose cost is set by its difficulty.
Touching a wraith or Spectre: contested Willpower; Angst drained a success.

states.incorporeal: A Skinlands blow: 1 bashing and Incorporeal for Stamina rounds.
states.wavering: Corpus full of bashing: 2 bashing each time she goes Incorporeal; lethal or aggravated starts a Harrowing.
